label: Reactor
description: Navigate a transport robot across a 7×5 reactor map from left to right without being crushed by vertically moving reactor blocks.

steps.label: Start game
steps.detail: Send 'start' command to initialise the reactor session and receive the initial map state

steps.label: Navigate to goal
steps.detail: Iteratively send right/wait/left commands based on simulated block positions until robot reaches col 7

steps.label: Receive confirmation
steps.detail: API confirms task completion once robot reaches the goal (col 7, row 5) without being crushed
